entries.name: Holding Thresher

counterPressure.note: One ability rider (a hold, not a kill) plus one modest raw-stat line; the muzzle's own throughput is unremarkable next to a heirloom-rung rare, and everything it's actually good at is the thing the stat sheet can't show.

entries.flavor: It does not spray to kill. It sprays to keep them exactly where they already made the mistake of standing.
entries.notes: armament-primary/control, row 1 of 8. baseType item.plant-muzzle-b-002 (role armament-primary, class nozzle, band b) resolved against data/seed/items/base-types/plant-armament-primary-b.json. atom.buttering is a shipped status.apply family (butter), used here as a control rider on a weapon role rather than the raw-damage rider a generator pool would normally weight toward that slot — a generator-level role/family preference, not a machine rule, and fixed atoms are not drawn from the pool.

entries.name: Broad Bole

counterPressure.note: The cleanse is what the slot is for; the raw-stat line under it is deliberately unremarkable so the utility rider is the whole reason to wear it, not a bonus on top of a stat stick.

entries.flavor: Wide enough that two zombies could not get their hands around it together, if either still had the reach to try.
entries.notes: core-guard/utility, row 2 of 8. baseType item.plant-stem-b-008 (role core-guard, class heartwood, band b) resolved against data/seed/items/base-types/plant-stem-b.json.

entries.name: Armature of the Redoubt

counterPressure.note: The armour's own protection is deliberately the low-band line here; the sun income is the point of the piece, and against a heirloom-rung rare's guard values this reads as a thin defensive stat line carrying an economy rider.

entries.flavor: Every stalk it shelters keeps producing. A wall that also pays rent.
entries.notes: ward-array/economy, row 3 of 8. baseType item.plant-sheath-b-004 (role ward-array, class heartwood, band b) resolved against data/seed/items/base-types/plant-ward-array-b.json. atom.sunbloom is the shipped resource.economy family (on-kill sun, capPerMatch implemented in the runner per atom-family-library.md §3.5) placed on a shoulder-armour role instead of the pool's usual economy carrier — a generator preference, not a machine rule.

entries.name: Sporangium of Siege

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line at medium band, everything else riding on the on-hit rider — against a firstseed-rung rare's tier-4/5 attack lines this is a deliberately thin stat sheet.

entries.flavor: It does not scatter on the wind. It waits for a face to be close enough, then answers with the whole garden bed underneath it.
entries.notes: jewel-major/offense, row 4 of 8. baseType item.plant-pollen-b-009 (role jewel-major, class graft, band b) resolved against data/seed/items/base-types/plant-pollen-b.json. atom.searing-strike carries element:earth to match the theme's affinity. RUNTIME HONESTY: atom.searing-strike is a resource.delta family, lawn-live and battle-unsupported today per the effect-atom authoring spec's exemplar note — this item works on the lawn and rejects in battle until battle grows a grant path for that kind.

entries.name: Involucre of the Berm

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line plus a periodic heal; no burst mitigation and no damage line at all, which against a heirloom-rung rare's spread reads as a survivability item that recovers slowly rather than one that refuses to take the hit.

entries.flavor: Bracts folded tight as a berm's slope, closing back over whatever they lose the moment they lose it.
entries.notes: sense/survivability, row 5 of 8. baseType item.plant-bract-b-005 (role sense, class heartwood, band b) resolved against data/seed/items/base-types/plant-bract-b.json. RUNTIME HONESTY: atom.regeneration is a resource.delta family (OnTimer), lawn-live and battle-unsupported today per the effect-atom authoring spec's exemplar note — this item works on the lawn and rejects in battle until battle grows a grant path for that kind.

entries.name: Tamped Holdfast

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line at medium band under a firstseed rung's tier-4/5 window; the slow is the entire build-around and the boots offer nothing else.

entries.flavor: Packed so hard into the bed beneath it that the ground itself slows to match its pace, which is to say: none at all.
entries.notes: footing/control, row 6 of 8. baseType item.plant-roots-b-001 (role footing, class heartwood, band b) resolved against data/seed/items/base-types/footing/plant/b.json — chosen deliberately over item.plant-roots-b-002 (the base type's own 'Ancient Holdfast' entry) so the unique does not sit on the one base already carrying its head noun as a name.

entries.name: Cistern of Loam

counterPressure.note: A one-shot HP top-up rather than a sustained stat line, plus an on-death spawn rider; a heirloom-rung rare's rolled affixes would beat this on raw numbers every time.

entries.flavor: Holds more than it needs, on the theory that a siege eventually asks for everything you saved.
entries.notes: infusion/utility, row 7 of 8. baseType item.plant-glands-b-003 (role infusion, class heartwood, band b) resolved against data/seed/items/base-types/infusion/plant/b.json.

entries.name: Colony of the Foundation

counterPressure.note: One medium-band raw-stat line under a firstseed rung's tier-4/5 window; the income rider is generous specifically because a currency drip is not a raw stat and cannot itself win a fight.

entries.flavor: Every runner it sends out comes home carrying something. That is the whole of the arrangement, and it has held for longer than anyone digging here expected.
entries.notes: retinue/economy, row 8 of 8. baseType item.plant-runner-b-006 (role retinue, class graft, band b) resolved against data/seed/items/base-types/plant-runner-b.json — chosen deliberately over item.plant-runner-b-012 (the base type's own 'Inseparable Colony' entry) so the unique does not sit on the one base already carrying its head noun as a name.
